name: cap-formulate-recipe
description: Formulates a brewing recipe for a target style, volume and ABV: parses the brief, retrieves technique from the library, proposes a grain bill and hop schedule from the brew.ingredients catalogue, then computes OG/FG/ABV/IBU/SRM in SQL and saves it. The model never does the arithmetic.

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ question: $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.question }) }}
value.schema_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type:"object", properties:{ style:{type:"string"}, batch_size_l:{type:"number"}, target_abv_pct:{type:"number"}, descriptors:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} }, must_include:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} }, avoid:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} } }, required:["style","batch_size_l","target_abv_pct","descriptors","must_include","avoid"] }) }}

value.web_query: ={{ (() => { const b = $json; const terms = (b.must_include ?? []).filter(Boolean); return terms.length ? `${terms.join(' ')} homebrew ${b.style || 'beer'} how much to use and when to add` : `${b.style || 'beer'} homebrew recipe grain bill and hop schedule`; })() }}

parameters.query:
-- The published band and the observed practice in one round trip: both are
-- keyed on the same style string and both are needed by the same next node.
-- ⛔ `cohort` carries the RUNG. A cohort that relaxed to a different beer must
-- not be presented to the model as this beer's practice, so `Build propose
-- pack` drops the block entirely above rung 2 rather than caption it.
SELECT coalesce(ref.f_style_bands($1::text), '{}'::jsonb) AS bands,
       (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM nlq.find_cohort(
          $1::text, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))) c) AS cohort,
       (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) FROM nlq.cohort_stats(
          $1::text, ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))) s) AS practice;

nodes.name: Fit hops
nodes.notes: Scales every hop so the computed IBU lands inside the published band. ⛔ THE `avoid` INTERACTION IS RESOLVED HERE, and it is the reason IBU was left out of the gate when the gate was built: a brewer who asks for very little bitterness wants to sit BELOW the published floor, so enforcing that floor would fight a brief the prompt already honours. When `avoid` names hops or bitterness the floor is dropped entirely and the published ibu_min becomes the CEILING instead -- 'at or under the bottom of the style'. Otherwise the published band applies as written. No band, no change.
